reshape_weight_conv: reshape a 4D convolution weight tensor from C_out x C_in x k x k to (C_in x k x k) x C_out format
reshape_weight_linear: reshape a 2D linear weight tensor by transposing it for matrix multiplication compatibility
reshape_back_weight_conv: reshape a flattened weight tensor back to C_out x C_in x k x k convolution format from im2col layout
reshape_back_weight_linear: reshape a 2D linear weight tensor back by transposing it to original format
reshape_activations_im2col: reshape 4D activations N x C_in x H x W into im2col format for efficient convolution computation with configurable kernel, stride, and padding
